name: Click Guide
description: Shows where to click in the level, learned from your own good runs, so you can learn the click pattern.

enabled.name: Show markers
enabled.description: Draw the saved click guide in the level.

record.name: Learn from my runs
record.description: Record your clicks and update the guide when you get further than before. Turn off to keep the current guide frozen.

only-practice.name: Only learn in practice mode
only-practice.description: Only update the guide from practice-mode attempts.

approach-ring.name: Approach ring
approach-ring.description: A ring around the next click that shrinks onto it as you get close, so you can see the timing coming.

show-attempt.name: Show my clicks this attempt
show-attempt.description: Faint white marks where you actually clicked this attempt, to compare against the guide.

lookahead.name: How far ahead to show
lookahead.description: How far ahead of your icon markers appear, in units (one block = 30).

death-margin.name: Mistake buffer
death-margin.description: When you die, clicks this close before the death (in units, one block = 30) are not saved, because that's usually where the mistake was.
